terminologyProfile.descriptionRule: Use measurable 3D graphics terms. Avoid vague words unless they are paired with concrete geometry/material/shader parameters.

referenceCamera.note: Reference is a stylized perspective concept; use camera matching for comparison only. Photo projection is intentionally skipped.

objectClass.notes: The admitted front, side, front-three-quarter, and rear-three-quarter views describe one stylized classic rear-engine coupe. Geometry should match the concept sheet rather than claim manufacturing accuracy or use trademarked badges.

reasoning: The identity depends on a compound side silhouette: long low hood, upright windshield, near-flat roof crown, and continuous fastback rear arc.
Front and rear wheel openings must be carved negative spaces with painted arch lips; placing wheels against an uncut body is a reference-breaking shortcut.
The front view requires a wide low stance, exposed round headlamps embedded in raised fender crowns, a narrow black bumper strip, and small amber indicators.
The rear view requires a full-width dark red lamp band, horizontal engine grille, black bumper guards, and a single left exhaust outlet.
Five-spoke wheel repetition, separate wheel pivots, and stable axle sockets are required for both visual identity and game animation.

specDepthDecision.rationale: Complex is required because the four-view identity depends on a continuous compound body surface, true wheel-arch negative spaces, a shaped glazed cabin, repeated wheel hardware, layered PBR materials, and action-ready wheel pivots.

details.description: Sharp studio highlights ride over a saturated red base coat on the hood, roof, fenders, and doors.
A shallow center valley and two faceted shoulder planes run from the cowl toward the front bumper.
Two round headlamps are embedded into raised painted fender crowns rather than floating in front of the body.
A narrow black impact strip spans the front bumper below the painted nose.
Small rectangular amber indicator lenses sit inside the front bumper near each corner.
The front tire occupies a real cut-out negative space with a red faceted arch lip following the upper tire.
The rear tire is enclosed by a separate flared painted arch with a smaller visible gap than the old model.
Each wheel exposes five thick silver spokes, a recessed dark barrel, and a circular center cap.
A thick charcoal frame outlines the trapezoidal windshield and separates it cleanly from the red A-pillars and roof.
The side glass terminates in a rounded triangular rear quarter window under the fastback arc.
A thin dark cutline follows the front edge, rocker, and curved rear edge of the long coupe door.
A small horizontal black handle sits high on the door behind the side mirror.
Closely spaced horizontal black slats fill a recessed grille below the rear window.
A segmented dark-red lamp band spans nearly the entire tail between black end bezels.
Two chunky black vertical guards project from the rear bumper strip.
A single dark circular exhaust outlet exits below the left side of the rear bumper.

anatomy.note: Only meaningful when objectClass.primaryDomain is character or hybrid. Set applies=true and fill from forge/stage1_intake/extract_landmarks.py. See grimoire/character/reconstruction.md and grimoire/character/likeness_maximization.md.

definitionOfDone: At the admitted side view the hood, windshield, roof, fastback, wheelbase, wheel diameter, and wheel-arch openings read as the same stylized coupe rather than a generic sports car.
At the admitted front view the wide low stance, fender crowns, inset round headlamps, bumper strip, and amber indicators align with the concept.
At the admitted rear three-quarter view the roof-to-tail arc, rear grille, full-width lamp band, bumper guards, and left exhaust are present and correctly layered.
Wheels expose five spokes and remain independently named pivot groups compatible with the existing game animation.
Automotive paint, glass, rubber, metallic wheels, black trim, and lamp lenses remain visually distinct under neutral and grazing light.

rear roof-to-tail arc and lamp-band height comparison

antiShallowSpecRules: Do not proceed to code if qualityContract.qualityBar is unassessed.
Do not proceed to code if the spec only contains a root component for a moderate or complex object.
Do not proceed to code if required featureGroups are not represented by componentTree, materials, or repetitionSystems.
Do not proceed to code if visible local features are described only in prose and not attached to components/materials/evidenceRefs.
Do not proceed past structural-pass if attached child parts lack attachment.parentSocket, localStart, localEnd, embedDepth/overlap, and gapTolerance.
Do not pass material look-dev when albedo is reused as roughness, height, normal, or AO.
Do not pass material look-dev without macro, meso, and micro surface frequency bands for close-up materials.
Do not pass reference-fidelity material look-dev from a source image without usable referencePbr maps or an explicit documented limitation.
Do not patch a spec with extracted PBR maps when extraction confidence is below the target threshold unless the user explicitly accepts lower fidelity.
Do not place adjacent separate-geometry parts below 0.02 world-unit seam overlap (source: grimoire/build/geometry_patterns.md).
Do not satisfy raised or recessed relief, fasteners, or grip structure with a map alone when the feature affects form; use geometry or displacement (source: grimoire/build/geometry_patterns.md).
Adjacent components must overlap by at least 0.02 world units at shared seams (source: grimoire/build/geometry_patterns.md).
Raised or recessed relief and fasteners must be geometry, instanced micro-parts, or displacement; a map alone is an approximation (source: grimoire/build/geometry_patterns.md).
mustNotDo: Do not treat the original four-view sheet as one admitted image.
Do not use stacked boxes for the primary body silhouette.
Do not place tires in front of an uncut body shell.
Do not cover five spokes with a solid wheel disk.
Do not add Porsche text, crests, or trademarked badges.
Do not claim calibrated manufacturing accuracy from AI concept art.

mustMatch: side silhouette, wheelbase, wheel diameter, and real wheel-well negative spaces
front fender crowns with embedded round headlamps
fastback cabin and tapered quarter glass
rear engine grille, lamp band, bumper guards, and left exhaust
clear-coated red paint versus glass/rubber/metal/trim separation
niceToHave: subtle hood and door shut lines
low-poly facet flow closely following the concept

visualAcceptance.scoringRule: AI vision must inspect a side-by-side reference/render sheet and score the current pass from 0 to 1. Pixel-diff code may assist diagnostics but cannot approve a pass.

featureReviewPolicy.selectionRule: Choose only the most visually salient, identity-defining, user-prioritized, or high-risk semantic systems. Group repeated parts instead of reviewing every mesh. AI vision scores every selected feature from the same full reference/render pair.

specRefineTriggers: local feature not traceable to viewEvidence
codeRefineTriggers: spec is adequate but generated geometry/material does not match
lighting hides geometry or material response
stopCriteria: target fidelity reached or user accepts current approximation
remaining gaps require new reference images or manual art

screenshotPolicy.minimumEvidence: Each visual pass needs a reference image, rendered screenshot, side-by-side comparison sheet, AI vision score, layer scores, and critique before choosing continue.
screenshotPolicy.reviewPairRule: Compare the same camera/viewpoint whenever possible; do not judge a front reference against a random render angle.
screenshotPolicy.acceptanceAuthority: AI vision review of the comparison sheet. Code-generated pixel similarity is not sufficient evidence.

featureReviewTargets.name: Hood, windshield, roof, fastback, overhang, and wheelbase system
Open wheel wells, painted arch lips, and correctly sized five-spoke wheels
Raised fender crowns with embedded round headlamps and layered bumper

Engine grille, full-width lamp band, bumper guards, and left exhaust

browser render screenshot from your agent's browser/screenshot tool
single side-by-side full reference/render comparison sheet

referencePbrExtraction.acceptedLimitation: single-image extraction is reference-derived inference, not exact photogrammetry

mustAvoid: plastic-looking smooth bark, stone, cloth, foliage, or aged material
local color/detail described only in prose without material masks
claiming exact PBR recovery when confidence is below the target threshold
reference lighting copied without separating material readability

screenshotReview: Compare albedo palette and local color zones.
Compare cavity dirt, edge wear, stains, moss, scratches, or other local masks.
Compare key/fill/rim structure, exposure, tone mapping, background, and contact shadows.
Capture a neutral-light render to verify material readability without reference lighting.
Capture a grazing-light close-up to expose flat normals, uniform roughness, tiling, and plastic highlights.
Capture a reference-matched render from the same camera framing as the source.

actionReadiness.contract: Every macro/meso component should be generated as a stable named Object3D pivot node with a mesh child, action metadata, optional sockets, collider proxy, and destruction metadata.
requiredComponentFields: attachment for child appendages, connectors, limbs, tubes, handles, legs, horns, wings, branches, or cables
authoringRules: Do not collapse independently movable parts into one mesh.
Put transforms on component pivot groups, not only on raw meshes.
For attached child parts, put the pivot at the semantic root/socket and build visible geometry from localStart to localEnd.
Represent hinge, socket, detachable, and breakable intent even when no animation is implemented yet.
Use simplified collider proxies for runtime physics instead of visual mesh colliders by default.

destructionPolicy.fractureGroupNaming: Use stable semantic names such as body-shell, left-hinge, glass-panel, branch-segment.
destructionPolicy.debrisStrategy: Prefer detachable component groups and a small number of procedural fragments over random mesh explosion.

assumptions: The four crops are AI-concept views with small cross-view inconsistencies; the side view controls wheelbase and roof profile, front controls width/headlamp placement, and three-quarter views arbitrate volume.
No logo or manufacturer badge is modeled.
The existing local sphere physics and collision behavior remain unchanged.

repetitionSystems.description: Four named wheel pivot assemblies at two axle z positions and mirrored x positions.
Five tapered silver spokes rotated by 72 degrees around each wheel hub.
Eight horizontal dark grille slats following the rear deck plane.
Ten shallow red lens cells spanning the rear lamp band.
Repeated shallow circumferential tread bands on all tires.

buildPasses.goal: Match material color, roughness, bump, and local variation.
acceptance: Reference-derived albedo palette records dominant, secondary, and accent colors per visible material.
Each important material defines roughness variation and at least one normal/bump/displacement response.
Local material overrides, dirt/wear/stains/moss/chips/scratches or equivalent masks are tied to evidenceRefs.
Thin, transparent, reflective, wet, or fibrous materials document alpha/transmission/clearcoat/metalness/fiber response when relevant.
Generated preview uses procedural albedo/roughness/bump texture or vertex color variation instead of one flat color.
Generated preview uses independent PBR maps at 1024px or higher for the quality-first tier.
If source pixels are available, referencePbr extraction passed at confidence >= 0.7 or the pass is stopped/requesting better references.
Macro, meso, and micro surface frequency bands are visible at the intended review distance without obvious tiling.
AI vision comparison score meets selfCorrectLoop.visualAcceptance.threshold.

buildPasses.goal: Add procedural surface locality such as normal/bump/displacement, AO, dirt, stains, chips, grain, moss, scratches, and wear.
acceptance: Every required material feature group has local overrides or surfaceDetail tied to evidenceRefs.

reviewHistory.summary: The logo-free coupe is recognizable and action-ready, but the strict silhouette gate remains below threshold.
mismatches: fender crowns remain more bulbous than the concept
roof and rear deck transitions remain more planar
procedural lamp bezels remain thicker than reference

use shaped fender crown sections instead of intersecting ellipsoids
curve roof cap and rear shoulders with more longitudinal stations

performanceBudget.qualityPriority: reference-fidelity within a small browser-racing asset
performanceBudget.optimizationPolicy: Use shared materials and instancing for spokes, grille slats, lamp cells, and tread bands after the four-view silhouette is accepted.

lightingFromPhoto: Key light: large soft studio source above camera-left/front, neutral white, intensity about 3.0; preserve broad clearcoat highlights without baking them into albedo.
Fill and environment: low-contrast neutral studio environment with soft camera-right fill, ACES filmic tone mapping, exposure 1.0, warm light-gray background.
Rim and ground: soft rear/upper rim to separate the roof and quarter panels, plus blurred contact shadow and ambient occlusion directly under all four tires.
proceduralStrategy: Derive the side-profile station heights and axle placement from the admitted side crop.
Derive width, fender-crown height, hood valley, and headlamp centers from the admitted front crop.
Generate a variable-section indexed body loft; omit lateral faces inside wheel-well intervals and build separate painted arch lips.
Generate the cabin as its own variable-width fastback loft, then inset glazing polygons inside painted pillar borders.
Generate four named wheel pivots with smaller tire radius, recessed barrels, five exposed spokes, center caps, and tread bands.
Layer front and rear identity hardware as separate named geometry so it remains reviewable and action-ready.
Use reference-derived procedural PBR materials; do not project source lighting or reuse albedo for unrelated channels.
animationAnchors: root drives whole-vehicle translation and yaw
Body is the stable visual lean/pitch node required by Vehicle.js
Wheel_Front_Left and Wheel_Front_Right are independent spin/steer pivots
Wheel_Back_Left and Wheel_Back_Right are independent spin pivots
Socket_Front_Axle and Socket_Rear_Axle expose axle centers
destructionAnchors: body shell, glazing, bumpers, lamps, and wheels stay separate named groups even though the current game keeps collision and damage simulation local
risks: The primary front-three-quarter crop truncates a small part of the far rear; rear length is constrained by side and rear-three-quarter crops.
The front crop contains a neighboring-car sliver at the far left; measurements exclude that area.
Exact lens transmission and glass thickness cannot be inferred from stylized concept lighting.
